citations.excerpt: After the first outbreak of glossolalia (i.e. "speaking in tongues") in April 1906, the group began to grow and become racially integrated.

facts.value: Revival led by William J. Seymour at 312 Azusa Street in Los Angeles, a catalyst for the growth of American Pentecostalism.

citations.locator: Timeline: William Seymour and Azusa Street Revival
citations.excerpt: The Azusa Street Revival functioned as an important catalyst to the growth of American Pentecostalism .

citations.locator: Timeline: William Seymour and Azusa Street Revival
